description: Michael (Apt 2) is at the building the evening before check-in, cannot get in, and asks for the apt number. Production auto named Apt 2 as if he could enter today (Jeffrey still in the unit). Must tell him today is not check-in day, check-in is tomorrow at 4pm, and the door code is not on the lock yet. Do not send lockout/backup codes. Do not call live Hospitable.
guestMessage: The door code is not working, we can't get in. Can you please confirm what our apt # is?

context.suggestedResponseSnippet: Good afternoon, Michael, today is not your check-in day — check-in is tomorrow at 4pm. The door code is not on the lock until the morning of your arrival, which is why you can't get in. You're in Apt 2 at 53 Pine Street starting then. See you then!

requiredPhrases: door code is not on the lock

notes: Michael 2026-08-20 6:05pm ET Apt 2. Real first guest text was 'Hello! Can you please confirm what our apt # is?' then they could not get in. Check-in 2026-08-21. Deterministic _applyNotCheckinDayAccessPolicy. Schlage codes now push at 5AM ET on check-in day.
